subject: Penetration test report and CAIQ/SIG evidence mapping for Akropolis Health
messages:
From: Liam Byrne <liam@akropolis-health.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: security@akropolis-health.com, grc-portal@akropolis-health.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Pen test report + CAIQ/SIG evidence mapping for GRC intake

Hi Sean,

Quick intro — I'm Liam on the Akropolis security intake team. As part of our supplier risk intake for our pilot contract, we need the penetration test report that covers the environment serving production (hosted inference). The SOC-2 review flagged a required artifact: a pen test report (redacted is ok) plus a CAIQ/SIG mapping showing which pen test findings map to vendor controls.

Can you: 1) provide the redacted report or a plan/timeline for redaction, 2) upload the report and a CAIQ control mapping spreadsheet into our intake portal (I can accept a pre-signed upload link), and 3) include a current remediation tracker for any open findings referenced in the report.

Deadline: if possible, can we get the artifacts by end of next week (2027-04-30) to stay on our compliance window? If redaction will take longer, please send an interim summary and a timeline.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Liam Byrne
Security Intake | Akropolis Health
liam@akropolis-health.com

Attachments: none
From: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
To: Liam Byrne <liam@akropolis-health.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Pen test report + CAIQ/SIG evidence mapping for GRC intake

Liam — thanks for the clear ask.

Short answer: we can provide a redacted pen test report and a CAIQ/SIG control mapping spreadsheet, and we'll include a remediation tracker that lists open findings with status and owner.

Plan / next steps:
- Internal owners: Vanessa (Security Ops) will coordinate redaction and upload; Marissa (GRC) will prepare the CAIQ mapping and the remediation spreadsheet.
- Target: initial redacted report plus mapping and a tracker by 2027-04-27. If redaction takes longer, we'll send a short findings summary by 2027-04-23.

Can you confirm the intake portal prefers PDF uploads or a combined ZIP? Also, do you need a CSV or the XLSX version of the control mapping?

I'll loop Vanessa and Marissa on this thread.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Director, Customer Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 415 555 0123

Hi Liam / team — Vanessa here. Short status update and requests from our side: we have the raw pen test deliverable from March (third-party vendor). Before we upload to your portal we need to: 1) redact tester and sensitive customer identifiers, 2) scrub any PII that is not relevant to the findings, and 3) map each finding to the CAIQ control(s) it demonstrates or impacts.

What I'm attaching here:
- caiq-control-mapping.xlsx (draft): includes one row per pen-test finding with columns: finding_id, severity, affected_component, CAIQ_controls, SIG_control_refs, remediation_status, owner, target_date.
- remediation-tracker-2027-04-22.xlsx (working): live tracker for open items (owner, status, evidence link).

Questions for Akropolis:
- Preferred upload format: ZIP (PDF + XLSX) works for your portal? If not, we can provide individual file uploads.
- For redaction: are there specific IP ranges or tenant names you'd like replaced with placeholders? We redacted per the standard non-disclosure rules but can apply custom placeholders if needed.

I'll aim to have a redacted PDF ready by Tue 2027-04-27. If you need an interim executive summary earlier, say by 2027-04-23, I can produce a 1-page summary listing top 5 findings and remediation commitments.

Vanessa Ortiz
Security Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

Attachments: caiq-control-mapping.xlsx (excel, 58KB); remediation-tracker-2027-04-22.xlsx (excel, 24KB)

To: Liam Byrne <liam@akropolis-health.com>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Request: Pen test report + CAIQ/SIG evidence mapping for GRC intake — Upload complete

Hi Liam / Akropolis intake team — Marissa here from GRC. Quick update and what I uploaded to your portal:

What we uploaded (links provided in portal):
- redwood-pt-report-2027-03-redacted.pdf — redactions applied to tester identities and customer-specific artifacts; findings retained with remediation notes.
- caiq-control-mapping.xlsx — finalized mapping: each finding has CAIQ and SIG references and suggested evidence attachments.
- remediation-tracker-2027-04-23.xlsx — current status: 3 open low findings, 2 medium findings in remediation (owners and ETA included).

Portal upload details:
- Portal reference ID: REDWOOD-PT-2027-03 (Akropolis GRC upload)
- Upload method: portal web UI under vendor intake; files uploaded as a ZIP and individual files also attached.
- Confidentiality: report redacted; full unredacted artifacts are held under legal request basis only.

If you need us to attach sample evidence (screenshots, config dumps) for specific CAIQ controls, tell us which control IDs you want prioritized and we'll attach the supporting artifacts to the portal record.

Regards,
